title: Bentonville Film Festival Sets 2027 Dates, Variety’s Producers to Watch Returns for 3rd Year
content:
ByTanya Fedak

TheBentonville Film Festivalwill return for its 13th year June 14-20, renewing its partnership withVariety’s 10 Producers to Watch for its third consecutive year.

Founded in 2015 by Geena Davis, the festival fosters and celebrates authentic storytelling through film screenings, industry conversations and community experiences.

“Over the past 12 years, BFF has championed the artistry of thousands of talented filmmakers, creating opportunities to showcase stories that have been overlooked,” Davis said. “As we look ahead to 2027, we remain committed to expanding our reach, connecting filmmakers with audiences and celebrating the power of storytelling to bring people together.”

Leigh Hopkins has also been appointed to BFFoundation’s board of directors after previously serving as the executive vice president and regional CEO for Asia and Mexico for Walmart International.

“We are thrilled to welcome Leigh to the BFFoundation board,” said Wendy Guerrero, the president and CEO of BFFoundation and the BFF. “His leadership experience, commitment to community and understanding of the region will be valuable as we continue to grow the festival, strengthen our partnerships and expand opportunities for filmmakers and audiences.”

Hopkins added, “I’m delighted to join the BFFoundation board and be part of a festival that not only brings outstanding films to Bentonville, but also creates meaningful community connections through its year-round programming and events. It’s an honor to help shape what’s ahead for BFF.”

The 2026 festivalfeatured 34 feature competition films, with winners including Walter Thompson-Hernández’s “If I Go Will They Miss Me” for best narrative and Judd Ehrlich’s “Jane Elliott Against the World” for best documentary.

See key dates for 2027 festival submissions below.
title_zh: 本頓維爾電影節(Bentonville Film Festival)確定2027年日期，《綜藝》(Variety)的製作人觀察(Producers to Watch)活動第三年回歸。
content_zh:
由塔尼亞·費達克(Tanya Fedak)報導

本頓維爾電影節(Bentonville Film Festival)將於6月14日至20日回歸，迎來第13屆，並與《綜藝》(Variety)的「10位值得關注的製片人」合作，這是連續第三年。

該電影節由吉娜·戴維斯(Geena Davis)於2015年創立，旨在通過電影放映、行業對話和社區體驗來促進和慶祝真實的故事講述。

戴維斯表示：「在過去的12年裡，本頓維爾電影節一直在支持數千位才華橫溢的電影製作人的藝術創作，創造了展示那些被忽視故事的機會。展望2027年，我們將繼續致力於擴大影響力，將電影製作人與觀眾聯繫起來，並慶祝故事講述的力量，讓人們團結在一起。」

萊伊·霍普金斯(Leigh Hopkins)也被任命為BFFoundation董事會成員，此前他曾擔任沃爾瑪國際(Walmart International)亞太和墨西哥區的執行副總裁及區域首席執行官。

BFFoundation及本頓維爾電影節的總裁兼首席執行官溫迪·格雷羅(Wendy Guerrero)表示：「我們非常高興歡迎萊伊加入BFFoundation董事會。他的領導經驗、對社區的承諾以及對該地區的理解將對我們持續發展電影節、加強合作夥伴關係以及擴大電影製作人和觀眾的機會大有裨益。」

霍普金斯補充道：「我很高興能加入BFFoundation董事會，成為這個不僅為本頓維爾帶來優秀電影的電影節的一部分，還通過全年節目和活動創造有意義的社區聯繫。能夠幫助塑造BFF的未來是一種榮幸。」

2026年的電影節展出了34部競賽影片，獲獎作品包括沃爾特·湯普森-埃爾南德斯(Walter Thompson-Hernández)的《如果我走了，他們會想念我嗎》(If I Go Will They Miss Me)獲最佳敘事片，以及賈德·厄爾里奇(Judd Ehrlich)的《珍·艾略特對抗世界》(Jane Elliott Against the World)獲最佳紀錄片。

以下是2027年電影節提交的關鍵日期。
